description:
Wrapper-level differential test for pkix_chain::verify_tls_client_dns against 'openssl verify -purpose sslclient -verify_hostname X'.

OpenSSL's sslclient purpose enforces clientAuth EKU. -verify_hostname applies SAN binding. This makes OpenSSL a stronger oracle for verify_tls_client_dns than pyca's ClientVerifier (which doesn't bind subject and doesn't enforce EKU under permit_all).

Acceptance:
- pkix-difftest/tests/verify_wrapper_openssl_client.rs covers the clientauth-DNS fixtures.
- baseline-verify-openssl.md gets a TLS-client section.

Blocks on PKIX-fmtv.18.1.
title: OpenSSL diff: verify_tls_client_dns vs -purpose sslclient -verify_hostname
